hypothesis: Repair source attribution and validation expectations for the inherited bounded canonical compact schedule without changing its legality, producer operations, scheduler or consumer semantics. Already admitted acyclic compact producers still split at a checked padded capacity with independent ordinary-LV stage widths; full-trip splitting remains preferred when storage fits.
semantics: Capture L.getStartLoc() before mutation. Set synthesized producer and consumer preheader branch locations to that exact original site, and retain that start as a standard DILocation operand on both stage loop IDs. Preserve it together with stage provenance when normal LV replaces IDs using explicit follow-up hints; stage remarks can continue using L->getStartLoc(), including on repeated LV. Rejections and Selected/ScalarFissionBound remarks use the captured site. No unknown-location checker fallback is admitted. Chunk admission still requires zero-start/unit-step control whose next IV exits on equality, the existing finite representable count proof, and checked padded scratch and pointer-index sizing. The acyclic branch-only graph, single common terminal participation edge, exact use-edge closure of every moved accumulator, calls/effects, strictfp/constrained-FP and final-export restrictions are unchanged; all rejection checks precede mutation. For a chunk starting at base, K=min(N-base,C)>0. The original producer executes K original iterations and paths. A separate ordinal increments at each latch; its final completed count is exported through the compact guard and advances base. P starts at zero on each producer-preheader edge; only the original participation block stores at old P and increments it. Every bypass forwards P unchanged. Inductively 0<=P<=ordinal<K<=C before each producer iteration, every participating store index is <C, and on exit 0<=P<=completed=K<=C. The guard consumes exactly P initialized contributions in original participation order. P=0 executes no consumer load or accumulator update and forwards the incoming chunk accumulator, including signed zero, rather than the function-entry start. Nonempty and empty results merge before the chunk backedge. Existing retained-state snapshots forward simultaneous original backedges through the producer exit on every chunk, including empty chunks; current/next/final inactive exports remain separate. All producer blocks enter the new parent LoopInfo membership while remaining mapped to their inner loop. Dedicated exits, topmost SE invalidation, DT recomputation, stage metadata, source-located remarks and recursive LCSSA assertions are retained. Actual transformed scalar and vector/scalar-tail paths are registered against separately renamed exact original IR and an independent nonchunked C oracle, with per-chunk probes of completed/P/consumer conservation, original state/control, old-P stores, empty bypasses and current/next exports. Only the harness may execute this verification.
costs: No new streams, retained-state arrays, participation masks, input rereads, producer duplication or contribution recomputation. Reuse the existing chunk min/remainder controller, producer ordinal, accumulator carries and retained-state backedge forwarding. Composition adds one completed-count forwarding PHI and retains the existing compact empty-stream guard, nonempty dedicated exit and result merge for each chunk. One runtime P==0 branch per chunk; no versioning/alias guards. LoopInfo insertion is O(producer blocks), with the existing linear acyclic/effect/use/export analyses and at-most-64-step monotone padded-capacity search; no new path enumeration, SSA reconstruction or profitability machinery. For the new shared i32+double fixtures, scratch per capacity C is alignTo(4*C,8)+8*C: C=1/8/9/16/65 reserves 16/96/112/192/784 bytes. At 15 bytes no slot fits; 111 bytes fits C=8, 112 fits C=9. Logical traffic is 12 bytes stored and 12 loaded per participating iteration, 24*sum(P_chunk) per row, zero for an empty stream; bytes are shared by both integer sums. Allocations are in function entry and reused across chunks/rows, independent of total runtime trips. Two retained integer carries and three reduction carries are exercised. The existing three-stream historical examples reserve C=64/B=1024 at ceiling 1043; single i32 streams reserve C=64/B=256 at ceiling 259. Validation-only probes reread inputs and compute independent expected results; that traffic is not generated compiler traffic. Physical stack use, spills, RVV traffic and speedup are not measured. This repair adds no executable operations, allocations, scratch traffic, input rereads, duplication or guards. Source preservation scans the small stage loop-ID operand list, creates an ID only when the exact start is absent, and adds no general analysis machinery. The dispatch mixed-stream capacities use alignTo(4*C,8)+8*C: ceiling 520 selects C=43/B=520; ceiling 519 selects C=42/B=504; ceilings 259/260 select C=21/B=256. Traffic remains 12 stored plus 12 loaded bytes per participant. Canonical export_compact/export_nested at ceiling 1043 select C=64/B=1024 for i32/double/float streams (16 stored plus 16 loaded bytes per participant); full-trip C=65/B=1044 remains unchanged. Metadata changes are not a speedup measurement.
limitations: This worker has not built LLVM, invoked compilers, run lit/unit/executable tests, machine-verified modules or compiled the primary corpus. Only source/diff/immutable-result review, Python AST parsing and whitespace inspection are allowed here. Every new result remains pending independent harness validation. Chunking still excludes affine/relational/reversed-equality control, multiple participation sites, nonterminal updates and unsupported CFG/effects/accumulator feedback. Multi-block unconditional producers keep their existing no-chunk restriction; no d2 changes are imported. New numerical producer state uses i32 with finite FP inputs including signed zero; inherited exceptional-FP cases remain. Existing state/FP/export/poison tests remain mandatory. The new narrow i8 fixture executes scalar consumers under both policies and LV1/LV2; scalable vectorization may conservatively leave it scalar, and its separate vector-policy lit/codegen run does not assert a vector width. i64 fixtures require actually entered vector consumers when fixed-vscale lanes fit capacity. EVL remains uninstrumented RVV codegen/machine verification only; host execution covers scalar and vector/scalar-tail layouts at fixed vscale, never RVV execution. No fast-math/errno assumptions, target speedup or newly selected immutable original target is claimed. t000064 has performed no compilation or test execution. Exact legacy dispatch/export chunk ceilings now have source-located scratch/stage and IR/codegen checks; their unchanged full-trip executable certificates retain their capacity-65 assumptions. The inherited new compact-chunk execution matrix exercises the actual chunked transformation on analogous diamond, larger acyclic, narrow and enclosing-row programs; this repair does not claim separate numeric execution of the legacy 520/1043-ceiling variants. The 48 new attribution-only compiler configurations are lit obligations, not numerical comparisons.
